note: Both sets capture the same core facts (FFA-W3 family, EllipSys2D, cylinder Cl/Cd, linear interpolation above 48% thickness, Snel in HAWC2, Du-Selig in OpenFAST, no 3D correction in the data). Set B additionally captures the important polar-mix specification (30% fully turbulent / 70% transitional) that Set A omits entirely. However, B's third claim ('laminar-to-turbulent transition ratio 30% and 70% %') is a garbled, misread restatement of the same sentence and duplicates B's other two ratio claims. On balance B is better: it adds two correct, engineering-relevant facts at the cost of one wrong duplicate, while A leaves the mixing ratio out.
remarks: Both sets repeat the 'aeroelastic simulations | airfoil data source' fact twice (once with and once without the EllipSys2D detail). The 30%/70% split is bound to fully-turbulent vs. transitional by the order of mention in the sentence; the text does not label the ratios explicitly, so that binding is inferred. Set B's '30% and 70% %' claim has a malformed unit and should be dropped as a duplicate of its other two ratio claims.
